[list]──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
[b]The Pirn government plans to merge administrative regions.
[sub]Le gouvernement de Pirn prévoit de fusionner des régions administratives.[/b][/sub]
──────────────────────────────────────────────────────[/list]

[i][b]P I R N ─[/b][/i] On 02 June, the [b]Pirn Parliament[/b] unveiled a proposal known as the [b]Merger Plan,[/b] or simply [b]Plan 8,[/b] aiming to consolidate the countrys administrative regions from 13 down to 8. The plan also includes consideration of granting [b]Victoria Region[/b] on [b]Chester Island [i](Bésart)[/i][/b] autonomous status under the name [b]Autonomous Region of Victoria[/b]. This is regarded as one of the most sweeping administrative reforms in Pirns history since the last major restructuring in 1963. Not only would the number of regions be reduced, but Pirn would, for the first time, establish a single autonomous region. According to policymakers, the current number of regions has become excessive and no longer reflects Pirns present circumstances. Meanwhile, the push to grant Victoria a degree of autonomy stems from its demographic makeup, where human residents significantly outnumber furry citizens.

Nevertheless, the plan has sparked considerable controversy. Many residents in several regions fear losing their local identities, and lawmakers caution that the merger must be approached with careful planning to avoid transferring old regional problems directly onto newly formed ones.

▌[i]I believe we must examine this merger seriously and cautiously. Such a move risks not only fueling public dissatisfaction but also placing an immediate burden on the new regional authorities if the issues of the old regions are suddenly passed on after consolidation. For example, Region Rupert currently suffers from severely underdeveloped infrastructure, yet it is slated to merge with the rapidly growing Orange Region. This merger would almost certainly slow Oranges momentum. Residents from Rupert would likely flock to Orange, causing population declines in several Rupert provinces while Orange struggles to cope with a sudden surge of migrants,[/i] independent MP [i]Simonette Lévêque[/i] said before Parliament.

For now, Plan 8 remains in the proposal stage and continues to undergo revisions, scrutiny, and debate within Parliament. Public opinion is sharply divided: supporters view it as a turning point that could reshape Pirns future, while critics warn that the risks are too great, concerns amplified by Lévêques remarks, particularly the fear that newly merged regions may be forced to shoulder the economic or social burdens of troubled former regions.

[list]──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
[b]Prime Minister Jackson Rearden was removed from office in a parliamentary vote of confidence.
[sub]Le Premier ministre Jackson Rearden a été destitué par un vote de confiance du Parlement.[/b][/sub]
──────────────────────────────────────────────────────[/list]

On 27 May, a political earthquake shook Pirn as Prime Minister [i]Jackson Rearden[/i] was ousted in a confidence vote initiated by opposition factions in Parliament. Rearden was removed with 76% voting in favor [i](vote of no confidence)[/i] of his dismissal, while only 30% voted against [i](vote of confidence)[/i], and the remainder abstained. With this outcome, Rearden officially becomes the first prime minister in more than two decades to be forced out of office, the last being former Prime Minister [i]Lancelot Martel[/i] in 2000. According to political analysts, the fall of the Rearden government was unforeseen, prompting widespread surprise and speculation over possible ballot irregularities.

▌[i]I was shocked when I learned that Reardens government had been voted out. While Im aware that he made mistakes in certain policies, particularly in economics and social affairs, he did succeed in creating more job opportunities for recent graduates, curbing runaway oil prices, and addressing a number of environmental and corruption issues,[/i] said [i]Thalia Valdez[/i], Associate Professor of Political Science and Economics at the Pirn University of Politics and Economics, in an interview with reporters. Valdez expressed surprise and noted that Reardens downfall had been largely unexpected even among seasoned observers.

Meanwhile, social media and public discourse erupted. Reardens supporters voiced disappointment over his removal, while opposition supporters celebrated the outcome. Yet the prime ministers ouster has also heightened anxiety among many citizens, who fear signs of political instability. Although [i]Monica Franklin[/i] was swiftly appointed the new prime minister, becoming the first woman in Pirns history to hold the office, the move has done little to assuage public concern.

[spoiler=[b][i]Operation Blooming Lotus[/i][/b]
[sub]Aokashimi Involvement in Lyuongo[/sub]]

Aoka Air Forces from three separate bases were readied for the first strikes on the LNSA. The importance of their mission was stressed to them, as the City of Uirn is weak and doomed to fall if their strikes are not accurate. The Aerial Strike Package includes 15 5th Generation Fighters, 45 4th Generation Multirole Fighters, and 20 Strike Aircraft. This package is supported by three Aerial Early Warning Aircraft and a contingent of Aerial Refueling Aircraft. These forces would form the second strike wave, only to be deployed following the initial strike by 100 One Way Unmanned Aerial Systems. These drones would be targeting the following locations: LNSA Command Posts, LNSA Radars, LNSA SAM Installations, LNSA Air Bases, LNSA Troop Gathering Points. All of these locations would have been identified and verified by Aokashimi Geospatial Intelligence Operators, and their Signals Intelligence Counterparts. The first strike with the drones would be monitored by a flight of 10 High Altitude Long Endurance (HALE) drones to ensure that it had good effect. If the strikes were considered successful, the greenlight would be given for the second strike package to begin their attacks. If the attack was not successful, another 100 One Way Strike Drones would be launched to ensure that the job was completed. If the second strike package of drones were not successful, the Operation would be scrubbed for the day, and resumed in three days time. (See the Naval Strike Package for more information about what happens if the original operation is scrubbed.)

The Naval Strike Package (Task Force Lotus) would also begin to move at this time, this strike package contains the following: 1 Light Aircraft Carrier, 7 Destroyers, 15 Frigates, 10 Corvettes, 5 Mine Warfare Vessels, 10 Diesel Electric Submarines. This strike package has a delayed start, as their first priority would be to establish a Naval Blockade of Lyuongo. They would be laying in wait there, enforcing the blockade until the Naval Task Force from [nation]Basadihsthan[/nation] arrived to support their approach to the mainland. While enforcing the blockade of Lyuongo they would not allow any vessels to pass that cannot prove, without a doubt, that they are supplying the Government of Lyuongo. Any vessels with stories that do not check out, or that can be found to be supplying the LNSA will be turned away. Any vessels that attempt to run the blockade will be boarded and have their vessels seized, if the vessel fires upon Aokashimi Naval Assets or Personnel, it will be sunk without prejudice or warning. 

As the Naval Task Force moves into position, all vessels (minus the Submarines, more info on those later) will have their radars on. They will be scanning for all emitting vessels or object within their missile range. As soon as they find an item that is emitting, and can confirm that it is LNSA affiliated, it will be struck with a missile. Anything that locks a Aokashimi Naval Vessel with its radar, will be struck with a missile. This will also be noted on a NOTICE TO ALL SEAMEN, that is put out on international shipping news. This force's main target is to destroy any Coastal Defense Platform, Coastal Radar, Inland Radar, LNSA Vessel, or LNSA Aerial Asset which is stupid enough to get within missile range of it. 

The Submarines of Task Force Lotus will remain stealthy and underwater, three will patrol outside of the blockade, identifying ships which are approaching the blockade. The other four will be operating within the blockade, scanning LNSA Ports to see what is operating where. If at anytime they find a LNSA Vessel operating alone, or a LNSA vessel with no ASW capabilities, they will utilize wake-homing torpedoes to ensure the quick destruction of the enemy vessel. No warning will be issued to these vessels unless they are unarmed. If the vessels are unarmed, they will be given one warning 10 minutes prior to the first torpedo launch, a second warning 5 minutes prior, and a final warning 2 minutes prior. No unarmed merchant vessels will be struck unless they are carrying LNSA Military Personnel. 

If the original strike package of 100 One Way drones is ineffective, and a second strike of an additional 100 drones does not do enough damage to make way for the second strike package, then Task Force Lotus will move the blockade closer to the Coast of Lyuongo and begin a methodical elimination of any assets that can be identified as hostile. This is also when the Light Aircraft Carrier will begin to launch SVTOL capable 5th and 4th Generation Fighters to begin bombing coastal defense platforms, and the missiles of the Task Force will be expended to do the maximum amount of damage to LNSA assets as possible. This will continue for the three day wait period, when finally, on the 4th day, the original second strike package will reunite and begin their strikes on LNSA positions. 

Meanwhile, while all of this is happening, Aokashimi Assets will be working to ensure that LNSA Radio Communications are jammed and completely ineffective. If they used a phone based communications system then the Aokashimi Cyber Warfare Squadron will be attempting to hack into it and find out what their enemy is doing. They want to ensure that there is no way for long range communications to happen easily between the different upper level commanders of the LNSA. 

[/spoiler]

The diplomats begin to brief the various topics that they want to agree with the Iroccons with; recognising each other's government, embassies in both nations, trade routes, small scale immigration/settlement of the Empire's frontiers and much more which will bring a great deal of benefits to both nations. It is also planned that the responsibility of the Christian minority and temporary workers and tourists in Irocco be given to Balionic clergy of various denominations. [spoiler=A unified people and the path forward.]
Throughout the Kuhaw-Astan celebrations was had as the people took a short break from the hard work of rebuilding to celebrate the fact that the many tribes that descended from the East-Aboriginals that migrated to this area of Erene over 9000 years ago was finally united for the first time in probably as many millenias.

The assembly of tribes that made up the current government on the other hand had much work on their hands that had to be done for the nation to prosper in the future.
First was the continued rebuilding effort that was far from finished even if they had made good progress. The many mines and refineries were starting to get properly online again which gave them refined metals and minerals to sell on the world market for much needed national income, but true prosperity could only come if they could get their plans for a large electronics sector fully going.

Whit the Yaburung tribes joining came not only the useful metals of their island but also their largest company, The Auronics Corporation, who specialized in certain electronics components such as CPUs, RAM sticks and SIM cards, as well as a state university that focused on Computer engineering and Electrical engineering to make sure that their company had good access to high quality employees.
They had already agreed to help them create new electronic companies for the nation by allowing young people of promise to be taken into the university but had also freed educated engineers to form the first new Kuhawan company Meup-meup Industries.

While the island of the Bala tribe did bring iron to the nation they were also a people that had not been really wealthy and as such there would have to be made investments in their infrastructure as well as the government and community infrastructure facilities, though at least these were functional and not ravaged by war.
They also had a singular airport that was in need of proper expansion and modernization but this was not seen as a very negative task as it would bring not only bring them closer to the rest of the nation but also provide tactical advantages as it was one of only three parts of the nation had space for a large airport, with the other places being the island of Astan and the land of Dulili-Wanja.

The land of the Djuwa and Qawma tribes also brought some new metals to the nation for them to use but also gemstones, such as Jasper and Epidote, and a not insignificant jewelry sector that when presented to the assembly of tribes made some bring up the prospect of investing and expanding this sector by using the gemstones that could be found in Astan together with the gold, silver and smokey quartz of Tocalgala island that they now had access to.
This idea found quick approval among the representatives of the assembly as it could be done in good speed and within very acceptable costs as the jewelers already existed and the expansions of their workshops would not be an expensive investment for even their nation, this would create a new flow of economic income that would really help them in their planned investments in electronics, the representatives of the Djuwa and Qawma tribes did use this excitement of economic growth to bring up the matter that many tribes were not excited to talk about though.

The one of the representative of the land of Dulili-Wanja, one Daku al-Karim, brought up the fact that not only did they need to discuss and agree in the legal and civil rights of the shaman population in Kuhaw-Astan, especially on the island of Astan, but the agreement to expand their jewelry sector into a nationally important one brought with it the opportunity to give the shaman people of Astan a physical proof that they had a potentially good future as a harmonical part of the nation by creating jewelry jobs for them as the largest mines that the nation got its Malachyte, Azurite and some of its Zircon gemstones from were close to the majority of Astans shaman population.
This would give them a much needed job opportunity to gain the ability to have an income to support their families with, and the Djuwa and Qawma would gladly provide good teachers and take on the cost of tools for them so that they would be able to do their new jobs well.
While the representatives of the more traditional and nationalistic tribes were not too fond of this idea they would find themself in the minority in the assembly as even the more neutral tribes saw it as a good idea to ensure stability and harmony in the young nation as they would need time to properly discuss and eventually implement the rights of the shaman people.

The representatives of the Mana tribes also managed to convince enough of the assembly to agree to the legally binding mandate that the issue of shaman rights needed to be agreed on and written in binding law before the end of 2030 so that no changes in the government in that 2030 election could sabotage this work and put the nation's stability and unity in danger of falling into chaos and even potentially a civil war.
With this agreed upon in the tribal assembly the young nation of Kuhaw-Astan would move forward into the rest of 2028, and most likely all of 2029, with a busy schedule of both legal, economical and political issues and decisions to be worked through.
[/spoiler]

[spoiler=Modernizing an old trade agreement.]
Throughout their history Nordiheim had not often been very friendly towards monarchies and empires ruled by nobles and families claiming royal blood, as they had learned a certain amount of hostility towards them from their wars and dealings with their own overthrown nobles, this of course had also extended towards the [nation]Tranvalia[/nation] lands that would over time evolve into an empire.
While no great wars of conflicts would be made with them to create long term enmity or grudges with them Nordiheim would nonetheless refuse to do any great trade or diplomacy with them.

Nordiheims economic problems and stagnation that struck the nation in the late 50s and early 60s would start to change this fact. As the nation's counsel struggled to with economic stagnation and fighting to prevent an economic collapse, a problem that would haunt Nordiheim until the 80s they would find that they had to change their view of who they were willing to trade with which would see them opening diplomatic and trade relations with nations that was kingdoms or empires that they had not been willing to deal with before.
The Empire of Tranvalia was one of these nations as they were one of the closest and their ruling family were open to their people having many freedoms that other monarchies did not allow, though the fact that they had many farms on fertile land that produced a lot of food can also be said to have helped.

After about 2 years of negotiations, both with the Tranvalians and the people back home in Nordiheim, a trade deal was signed between the two nations in August of 1964.
This trade deal mostly focused on Nordiheim gaining the ability to buy beer, maize and grains such as wheat that they grew quite a bit of, in return Nordiheim sold them iron at preferential prices.

This brings us to the modern year of 2028 where the now 64 year old trade deal was showing its age and was desperately in need of modernizing and re-negotiation to function properly in a modern economy as difficulties were starting to properly show itself.
There was also the fact that both sides had voiced the desire for some years to increase what goods and resources that were included in it, with oil being something that the Tranvalian Empire desired to gain proper access to. Thankfully the Nordiheimians had also learned over the 6 decades that the monarchy of Tranvalia was noting like how their own nobles had been like as the common people of the empire had wide freedoms and the emperors had showed a rather clear opinion that people of merit should be given important positions rather than those of "correct birth, something that had made the whole idea to increase trade and diplomatic ties with the empire far more acceptable than it had in the past.

As such the diplomat Larsin Bindison was being sent to the Empire of Tranvalia to achieve the following goals:
-An exchange of embassies between the two nations to widen the two nations diplomatic ties.
-Widening the trade deal to a general one that allowed full trade between the two nations.
-Offer the empire access to buy Nordiheimian [b]Oil[/b] in addition to [b]Iron[/b], both at fair market prices.
-The permission for entities in both nations to make investments in the companies and economy of the other nation following each other's laws and national restrictions.
-General permission for their citizens to travel between the two nations to encourage tourism and the exchange of cultural understanding between the nations.

The council of Nordiheim hoped that Emperor Alexander Karel von Halstern I and the States General of Tranvalia would be as open to these re-negotiations and enlargement of the old agreement as they had seemed to indicate in the recent years.
[/spoiler]

[i][b]Even with[/b][/i] the new developments of Aoka and Basadihsthani support, Thet Mg knew Uria only had a day or so at most to hold out for. The Navy had defected, and even if Mg could contact his LNA allies in the south, there would be no way of getting around the LNSA stronghold now splattered across western Lyuongo. Mg looked over the cheap board laid out in front of him. There were a lot more chocolates now on the ground then on the board. At this, Thet turned to look out the window, where he was met with a sea of rubble, broken up by the occasional fire. Shutting the blinds, Mg marched over to the other side of the room, feet kicking up dirt and bits and pieces of the concrete roof above that had cracked in the LNSA bombing raids. On a wooden shelf, Mg picked up his silver revolver, to which he inspected it. "This may be the last bit of still shiny metal in this entire city..." he thought, before setting it back down. Mg walked back over to the table, ripped the map off of the table, kicked the table over, grabbed his rifle and left for the ever-shrinking front. 

From a third person's perspective, the front was now a perimeter with a radius of about 360 yards around Mg's makeshift HQ. The few tanks they did have were now reduced to a pile of scrap metal. Not like they were much of anything before being blown up... anyways, eventually Uria did fall. 4th of June, the year of our Lord two-thousand and twenty eight at fifteen-hundred hours and thirty-eight minutes was when the last LNA defender of Uria fell to the LNSA onslaught, announced by the LNSA. This marked the end of the first stage of the Lyuongoan Civil War, with both sides now split between the east and west of the great Lyuongoan Jungle. Tung Aung, now with an international coalition at his back, is being pressured by the mining companies to start an offensive in the north. However, President Tung wanted to stall until the Aoka Air Force could gain air dominance over Lyuongo. Deciding to straddle both lines, Tung ordered a bombing run of about 10 MiGs to take off from an air base in the city of Durgo to strafe Yapinaw, an admittably half-assed measure.
